newsitem.title: UK: United sells Norweb U.S. power plant stakes.
newsitem.headline: United sells Norweb U.S. power plant stakes.

text.p: British water and energy group United Utilities Plc said on Monday it had agreed to sell NORWEB's stakes in two U.S. power plants to U.S. investment fund Indeck North American Power Fund L.P. for around $40 million.
Norweb, a United Utilities subsidiary, holds 50 percent stakes in a 150 megawatt cogeneration plant in Florida and in a 240 megawatt plant in Virginia.

United said in February it was in talks to sell the stakes. The disposals are part of its divestment programme which United said had now raised around 459 million stg, above the original target of 350 million.
